title: Erlenmeyer Flasks

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)

purpose: Conical flasks with a narrow neck, commonly used for preparing and mixing media or broth cultures, and for shaking cultures.
safety: The narrow neck reduces splashing/evaporation and is convenient for stoppering or capping with foam/foil during autoclaving.
Do not fill beyond roughly half capacity when the contents will be agitated (e.g. on a shaker), to avoid spillage/foaming issues.
